description: Create, write, save, or place a new document or file in a knowledge base. For git knowledge bases: commits to managed branch. Chunks and indexes the new file. The sanctioned way for a filesystem-less agent to place a new document (e.g. a workbench doc). Use for persistent artifacts that should survive the session.
embedding_description: Create, write, save, add, or place a brand-new document or file that does not yet exist in a knowledge base, writing its initial contents. This is how an agent without filesystem access persists a new document, note, plan, report, or artifact so it survives the session and becomes searchable. For git-backed KBs the new file is committed to the managed branch, then chunked and indexed. Some knowledge bases require a metadata block in the content on create. This is the way to place a new workbench planning document: create it as a markdown (.md) file in the workbench knowledge base with the required metadata block (Date, Author, Status, Embedding Description, Summary). Use to write a new document, not to overwrite one that already exists (use edit_file for that).

result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: FileExistsError: file already exists. Use edit_file instead.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use edit_file to modify existing files.
